hypotheses.R0_edit_mode_preexists_value_projection: A split-0 rank-1 Layer-17 normalized-residual delta explains at least 50% of split-1 energy for both spelling and unrelated swaps.
hypotheses.R1_prevalue_mode_is_generic: The spelling and unrelated-swap rank-1 residual axes have absolute cosine at least 0.8.
hypotheses.R2_weights_map_residual_axis_to_value_ax: Mapping each fitted residual axis through the native H2 c_v slice has cosine at least 0.9 with its fitted value axis.
hypotheses.R3_value_projection_canonicalizes_the_mo: Rank-1 held-out energy rises by at least 0.10 from normalized residual to H2 value for both families.
hypotheses.R4_global_weight_outlier_is_the_data_mod: The leading left singular vector of the H2 c_v slice has cosine at least 0.5 with both fitted value axes.
